sources.title: Binance resumes bitcoin withdrawals after covering bulk of stolen $6.3 billion
claims: Reuters reports Binance's status page shortly after 06:00 GMT said planned withdrawals had begun; first phase covers 15 cryptoassets including BTC, ETH, XRP and DOGE.
Reuters reports Binance says it bought approximately $6B of replacement tokens using company funds; remaining 5% are less-liquid assets.

Reuters reports funding sources named by Binance: SAFU including a bitcoin reserve, Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury; co-CEO Yi He said 50% of SAFU funds would be used and replenished toward $1B.
limitations: Reuters reports the aggregate exchange recovery and phase announcement; it does not verify an XRP-specific successful withdrawal or XRP-specific purchase amount.

sources.title: Recovery Update #4 — 95% aggregate incident coverage and progressive phase-one withdrawals
claims: XRP is listed among the phase-one withdrawal assets for progressive availability during 06:00-09:00 UTC.
Binance reports 95% aggregate recovery and 100% coverage for the ten listed top assets including XRP and RLUSD.
limitations: Company-reported coverage; no XRP-specific purchase quantity or customer-withdrawal success.

sources.title: Deposit and withdrawal network status recheck
claims: Displayed last-updated text 06:53:22 AM with timezone undisclosed; rendered table showed 'No records' and no XRP-specific row.
limitations: An empty rendered table is not evidence of unavailability or successful XRP withdrawal.

sources.title: XRP escrow schedule and post-release state at XRPL ledger 108038942
claims: Tracker reports 1B XRP released at 00:00:02 UTC; zero re-escrow by ledger 108038942 at 05:39 UTC; 30.4B XRP remaining.
limitations: Raw transaction Destination fields and later disposition not independently decoded.

cross_corroboration_notes: Reuters and Binance both report the phase-one start and aggregate recovery, but Reuters is reporting Binance's own status page and statements; this is not independent on-chain confirmation.
XRP is included in the first 15 assets, but the Reuters article specifically confirms BTC withdrawals resumed; it does not document a successful XRP withdrawal.
Binance's approximately $6B replacement-token purchase is aggregate across stolen assets; no XRP-specific amount, venue or timing is disclosed.
The XRP escrow observation is a separate tracker-derived XRPL snapshot and is not causally linked to Binance's replacement purchases.
